props.description:
When another creature you can see loses Hit Points while in Crisis, if they are not undead, you gain 1 Grave Point. You may never have more than [SL + 1] Grave Points.

When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you lose all Grave Points; then, if you lost at least 1 Grave Point this way and this is the first time you are reduced to 0 HP during this scene, you do not Surrender nor Sacrifice yourself; instead, you recover an amount of HP equal to [SL, multiplied by the amount of Grave Points you lost this way].

props.description: You can always communicate verbally with undead creatures. Once per scene, you may ask an undead a single question; they are compelled to answer truthfully.
props.name: Children of the Grave

props.description: When you cast an 【⚡Offensive Spell】 with a target of “One creature”, you may spend 2 Grave Points to have the spell target all creatures you can see that are present on the scene (perform a single Magic Check and confront it with the Magic Defense of each target). If you do, all damage dealt by the spell becomes Dark and its type cannot change.
props.name: Rondo of Nightmare

props.description:
When you cast Drain Spirit or Drain Vigor, the amount of MP or HP you recover is equal to the MP or HP loss suffered by the target, respectively (instead of being halved).

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― Your Drain Spirit causes the target to lose [HR + 20] Mind Points.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― Your Drain Spirit causes the target to lose [HR + 25] Mind Points.
props.heroic_requirement: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Entropist and Necromancer, and must have learned both the Drain Spirit and Drain Vigor spells.
props.name: Harvester of Sorrow

props.description: As long as you have at least 1 Grave Point, you gain Immunity to Dark and Poison damage, Resistance to Physical damage, and Vulnerability to Light damage. These Affinities overwrite any other Affinity for those damage types, and cannot be altered in any way as long as you have at least 1 Grave Point.
props.heroic_requirement: you must have mastered the Necromancer Class
props.name: Pulse of the Maggots

props.description:
When a non-Villain NPC you can see that belongs to the beast, humanoid, monster, or plant Species dies, you may spend 2 Grave Points and reduce your maximum HP and MP by an amount equal to that NPC’s level. If you do, their corpse becomes a Minion who obeys your telepathic commands:

  • Its Species becomes undead and it receives all undead rules. The new Affinities to Dark, Light, and Poison damage overwrite any preexisting Affinity, but the original Species’ rules are otherwise maintained.
  • Its Rank becomes soldier; if the original creature was an elite or champion, the GM must reduce the Minion’s HP and MP accordingly (Skills are maintained).
  • The newly created Minion is a completely new creature and has full HP, full MP, and no status effects. It retains the original creature’s equipment.
  • Your Minion takes its own turn during conflicts, and the GM must count it as an additional Player Character when designing a conflict.
  • When you rest, your Minion also gains the full benefits of resting.
  • If your Minion is reduced to 0 HP, if you are more than 1 travel day away from it, or if you die or fall unconscious, your Minion is immediately destroyed.
  • You may also destroy your Minion at any time; if you want to create a new Minion, you must first destroy the current one.
  • If your Minion is destroyed, your maximum HP and MP scores return to normal.
props.heroic_requirement: you must have mastered the Necromancer Class.
props.name: Birth of the Cruel

props.description: After you cause one or more enemies to lose Hit Points, if you have acquired the Beyond the Realms of Death Skill and at least one of them is suffering from Shaken and/or Weak, you gain 1 Grave Point and recover [SL × 2] Hit Points and Mind Points.
props.name: Fear Is the Key
props.passive_logic_resolution:
const DEBUG = true;

const TAG = "[PL-RES][FearIsTheKey]";

const ctx = (typeof context !== "undefined" && context) ? context : {};

const p = (typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD) ? __PAYLOAD : {};

const globalTargets = (typeof __TARGETS !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(__TARGETS)) ? __TARGETS : [];

const skip = (reason = "") => {

if (DEBUG && reason) console.log(TAG, "SKIP:", reason);

return ctx.skipPassive ? ctx.skipPassive("", { notify: false }) : undefined;

};

const log = (...args) => {

if (DEBUG) console.log(TAG, ...args);

};

const warn = (...args) => {

if (DEBUG) console.warn(TAG, ...args);

};

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const asArray = (v) => Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v == null ? [] : [v]);

const collectionValues = (collectionLike) => {

if (!collectionLike) return [];

if (Array.isArray(collectionLike)) return collectionLike;

if (typeof collectionLike.values === "function") return Array.from(collectionLike.values());

return Array.from(collectionLike);

};

const toNumber = (v, fallback = 0) => {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

};

async function resolveDoc(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref !== "string") return ref;

try {

return await fromUuid(ref);

} catch (err) {

warn("fromUuid failed", { ref, err });

return null;

}

}

function actorFromDoc(doc) {

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Actor" || doc.constructor?.name === "Actor") return doc;

if (doc.actor) return doc.actor;

if (doc.object?.actor) return doc.object.actor;

if (doc.token?.actor) return doc.token.actor;

if (doc.document?.actor) return doc.document.actor;

return null;

}

async function resolveActor(ref) {

const doc = await resolveDoc(ref);

return actorFromDoc(doc);

}

function getActiveTokenForActor(actor) {

if (!actor) return null;

try {

return (

actor.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ??

actor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ??

null

);

} catch {

return null;

}

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 1) Read the trigger payload.

// This passive should only run from creature_deals_damage.

// --------------------------------------------------

const phaseRoot =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

const phaseByTrigger =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger ??

{};

const passiveTriggerKey =

p?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.reaction_trigger_key ??

phaseRoot?.trigger ??

null;

const triggerPayload =

phaseByTrigger?.creature_deals_damage ??

(passiveTriggerKey && phaseByTrigger?.[passiveTriggerKey]) ??

phaseRoot ??

{};

const triggerName = triggerPayload?.trigger ?? passiveTriggerKey ?? "";

if (triggerName !== "creature_deals_damage") {

return skip(`Wrong trigger: ${triggerName || "none"}`);

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2) Confirm the damage event actually caused HP loss.

// --------------------------------------------------

const hpBefore = toNumber(triggerPayload?.gmChanges?.hp?.from, NaN);

const hpAfter = toNumber(triggerPayload?.gmChanges?.hp?.to, NaN);

let dealt = 0;

if (Number.isFinite(hpBefore) && Number.isFinite(hpAfter)) {

dealt = Math.max(0, hpBefore - hpAfter);

} else {

dealt = Math.max(

0,

Math.abs(toNumber(triggerPayload?.finalValue, 0)) ||

Math.abs(toNumber(triggerPayload?.displayedAmount, 0)) ||

Math.abs(toNumber(triggerPayload?.baseValue, 0))

);

}

if (triggerPayload?.affected === false || dealt <= 0) {

return skip("Damage event did not cause HP loss.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3) Resolve passive owner and Fear Is the Key item.

// --------------------------------------------------

const owner =

ctx.passiveOwner ??

((typeof __PASSIVE_ACTOR !== "undefined") ? __PASSIVE_ACTOR : null);

const fearItem =

ctx.passiveItem ??

((typeof __PASSIVE_ITEM !== "undefined") ? __PASSIVE_ITEM : null);

if (!owner) return skip("Missing passive owner actor.");

if (!fearItem) return skip("Missing Fear Is the Key passive item.");

const fearSL = Math.max(0, parseInt(fearItem.system?.props?.level ?? "0", 10) || 0);

if (fearSL <= 0) return skip("Fear Is the Key SL is 0.");

// --------------------------------------------------

// 4) Detect Beyond the Realms of Death on the same owner.

// ID first, name fallback.

// --------------------------------------------------

const BEYOND_BASE_UUID = "Item.14ni8QTjG5uq5whY";

const BEYOND_NAME = "beyond the realms of death";

function itemSourceIds(item) {

return [

item?.uuid,

item?._stats?.compendiumSource,

item?.flags?.core?.sourceId,

item?.flags?.world?.sourceId,

item?.system?.props?.baseUuid,

item?.system?.props?.sourceUuid,

item?.system?.props?.uuid

].filter(Boolean).map(String);

}

const ownerItems = collectionValues(owner.items);

const beyondSkill = ownerItems.find(item => {

const ids = itemSourceIds(item);

if (ids.includes(BEYOND_BASE_UUID)) return true;

return norm(item?.name) === BEYOND_NAME;

});

if (!beyondSkill) {

return skip("Owner does not have Beyond the Realms of Death.");

}

const beyondSL = Math.max(0, parseInt(beyondSkill.system?.props?.level ?? "0", 10) || 0);

if (beyondSL <= 0) return skip("Beyond the Realms of Death SL is 0.");

const maxGrave = Math.max(1, beyondSL + 1);

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5) Resolve damaged target list from the damage event.

// --------------------------------------------------

function collectTargetRefs(src = {}) {

const refs = [];

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetUuid));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetTokenUuid));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetTokenUUID));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetActorUuid));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetActorUUID));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targets));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetTokenUuids));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetTokenUUIDs));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetActorUuids));

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetActorUUIDs));

for (const id of asArray(src.targetIds)) {

const tok = canvas.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.id === id || t.document?.id === id);

if (tok?.document?.uuid) refs.push(tok.document.uuid);

}

return Array.from(new Set(refs.filter(Boolean).map(String)));

}

let targetRefs = collectTargetRefs(triggerPayload);

if (!targetRefs.length) {

targetRefs = collectTargetRefs(p);

}

if (!targetRefs.length && globalTargets.length) {

targetRefs = globalTargets;

}

if (!targetRefs.length) {

return skip("No damaged target refs found in trigger payload.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 6) Check Shaken / Weak on any damaged target.

// ID first, name fallback.

// --------------------------------------------------

const SHAKEN_EFFECT_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.dnzpUdhxjd6H3ktJ";

const WEAK_EFFECT_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.62gUkhQExwD9DvaI";

const EFFECT_UUIDS = new Set([SHAKEN_EFFECT_UUID, WEAK_EFFECT_UUID]);

const EFFECT_IDS = new Set(

Array.from(EFFECT_UUIDS).map(uuid => String(uuid).split(".").pop())

);

const EFFECT_NAMES = new Set(["shaken", "weak"]);

function isTruthy(v) {

return v === true || v === 1 || v === "1" || norm(v) === "true" || norm(v) === "yes";

}

function actorHasShakenOrWeak(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

const effects = collectionValues(actor.effects);

// ID / source UUID first.

for (const eff of effects) {

if (!eff || eff.disabled) continue;

const effId = String(eff.id ?? eff._id ?? "");

const effUuid = String(eff.uuid ?? "");

const effOrigin = String(eff.origin ?? "");

if (EFFECT_IDS.has(effId)) return true;

if (EFFECT_UUIDS.has(effUuid)) return true;

if (EFFECT_UUIDS.has(effOrigin)) return true;

}

// Name / status fallback.

for (const eff of effects) {

if (!eff || eff.disabled) continue;

const effName = norm(eff.name ?? eff.label ?? "");

if (EFFECT_NAMES.has(effName)) return true;

const statuses = Array.from(eff.statuses ?? []).map(norm);

if (statuses.some(s => EFFECT_NAMES.has(s))) return true;

}

// Last fallback for your sheet boolean mirrors, if present.

const props = actor.system?.props ?? {};

if (isTruthy(props.isShaken) || isTruthy(props.shaken)) return true;

if (isTruthy(props.isWeak) || isTruthy(props.weak)) return true;

return false;

}

const affectedTargets = [];

for (const ref of targetRefs) {

const actor = await resolveActor(ref);

if (!actor) continue;

if (actorHasShakenOrWeak(actor)) {

affectedTargets.push(actor);

}

}

if (!affectedTargets.length) {

return skip("No damaged target has Shaken or Weak.");

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 7) Apply result:

// - Owner gains 1 Grave Point, capped by Beyond SL + 1.

// - Owner recovers HP and MP equal to Fear SL * 2.

// --------------------------------------------------

const props = owner.system?.props ?? {};

const graveBefore = Math.max(0, toNumber(props.clock_grave, 0));

const graveAfter = Math.min(maxGrave, graveBefore + 1);

const recoverAmount = Math.max(0, fearSL * 2);

const hpBeforeOwner = Math.max(0, toNumber(props.current_hp, 0));

const mpBeforeOwner = Math.max(0, toNumber(props.current_mp, 0));

const maxHpRaw = toNumber(props.max_hp, NaN);

const maxMpRaw = toNumber(props.max_mp, NaN);

const maxHp = Number.isFinite(maxHpRaw) && maxHpRaw > 0 ? maxHpRaw : hpBeforeOwner + recoverAmount;

const maxMp = Number.isFinite(maxMpRaw) && maxMpRaw > 0 ? maxMpRaw : mpBeforeOwner + recoverAmount;

const hpAfterOwner = Math.min(maxHp, hpBeforeOwner + recoverAmount);

const mpAfterOwner = Math.min(maxMp, mpBeforeOwner + recoverAmount);

const hpGained = Math.max(0, hpAfterOwner - hpBeforeOwner);

const mpGained = Math.max(0, mpAfterOwner - mpBeforeOwner);

await owner.update({

"system.props.clock_grave": graveAfter,

"system.props.current_hp": hpAfterOwner,

"system.props.current_mp": mpAfterOwner

});

log("APPLIED", {

owner: owner.name,

damagedTargetsWithShakenOrWeak: affectedTargets.map(a => a.name),

dealt,

fearSL,

beyondSL,

graveBefore,

graveAfter,

maxGrave,

recoverAmount,

hpBeforeOwner,

hpAfterOwner,

hpGained,

mpBeforeOwner,

mpAfterOwner,

mpGained

});

// --------------------------------------------------

// 8) Silent pseudo floating text feedback.

// Green = HP recovery, Blue = MP recovery.

// --------------------------------------------------

const ownerToken = getActiveTokenForActor(owner);

const casterTokenUuid = ownerToken?.document?.uuid ?? null;

if (casterTokenUuid && game.ONI?.pseudo?.play && (hpGained > 0 || mpGained > 0)) {

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) return;

const hpGain = Number(params.hpGain ?? 0) || 0;

const mpGain = Number(params.mpGain ?? 0) || 0;

if (hpGain <= 0 && mpGain <= 0) return;

const duration = Number(params.duration ?? 1150) || 1150;

const rise = Number(params.rise ?? 70) || 70;

const fontSize = Number(params.fontSize ?? 30) || 30;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

const container = new PIXI.Container();

container.x = casterToken.center.x;

container.y = casterToken.center.y - ((casterToken.h ?? 100) * 0.72);

container.zIndex = 10000;

container.alpha = 1;

function makeText(text, fill, yOffset) {

const t = new PIXI.Text(text, {

fontFamily: "Signika, sans-serif",

fontSize,

fill,

fontWeight: "bold",

stroke: "#000000",

strokeThickness: 4,

align: "center",

dropShadow: true,

dropShadowColor: "#000000",

dropShadowBlur: 3,

dropShadowDistance: 2

});

t.anchor.set(0.5);

t.y = yOffset;

return t;

}

let y = 0;

if (hpGain > 0) {

container.addChild(makeText("+" + hpGain + " HP", "#35ff63", y));

y += fontSize + 6;

}

if (mpGain > 0) {

container.addChild(makeText("+" + mpGain + " MP", "#36b7ff", y));

}

canvas.stage.addChild(container);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

function easeOutCubic(t) {

return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

}

await new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const startY = container.y;

const tick = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / duration;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeOutCubic(t);

container.y = startY - (rise * e);

if (t > 0.45) {

container.alpha = 1 - ((t - 0.45) / 0.55);

}

if (t >= 1) {

canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick);

resolve();

}

};

canvas.app.ticker.add(tick);

});

canvas.stage.removeChild(container);

container.destroy({ children: true });

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "fearIsTheKey.recoveryFloatText",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: {

hpGain: hpGained,

mpGain: mpGained,

duration: 1150,

rise: 70,

fontSize: 30

},

meta: {

source: "Fear Is the Key",

ownerActorUuid: owner.uuid

}

});

} else {

log("Pseudo floating text skipped.", {

hasCasterToken: !!casterTokenUuid,

hasPseudoApi: !!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play,

hpGained,

mpGained

});

}

props.class_lore:
The arts of soul manipulation have seen a wide variety of uses, but few will strike an instinctual fear in the hearts of people as Necromancy can.

Necromancers reap spiritual energy moments before death, when it is at its brightest; this precious power can then be used to fuel their control over the balance of life and death, or even to inhabit a corpse so that it moves again. And yet, as if to mock their dark efforts, true resurrection of a lost one remains a mirage...
